title: Minimum Insertion Steps to Make a String Palindrome
description: Given a string `s`, in one step you can insert any character at any index of `s`. Return the minimum number of steps needed to transform `s` into a palindrome.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Characters belonging to the longest palindromic subsequence already mirror each other and need no insertions.
The minimum insertions equal len(s) minus the length of the longest palindromic subsequence.

examples.explanation: "zzazz" is already a palindrome, needing 0 insertions.
"leetcode" needs 5 insertions to become a palindrome.
